guides.first_step: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum is automatic: it pops the moment the last of the 54 is yours, so treat it as a progress meter, not a task of its own.
guides.watch_out: Nothing here is missable on its own — but the four missable trophies in stage 2 can block it, so clear those before the story moves past them.

guides.first_step: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. The trophy pops when the mission completes.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story trophy. If it has not popped, the opening mission is not finished yet.

guides.first_step: Finish Chapter 1 in full — every mission in the chapter, in story order. The trophy pops at the chapter's end.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable. Chapter progress is the only requirement; side activities do not count toward it.

guides.first_step: Finish Chapter 2 in full. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story trophy. The official description names only the chapter, so no extra step is needed.

guides.first_step: Finish Chapter 3 in full. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable. Keep following the story missions; nothing optional is required for it.

guides.first_step: Finish Chapter 4 in full. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story trophy.

guides.first_step: Complete the final mission of the game. This is the story's gold trophy and it pops when the last mission ends.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable, but it is the end of the road: finish the four missable trophies first, because some of their windows close with the story.

guides.first_step: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. The trophy pops when the mission ends.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story mission trophy. The official description names only the mission.

guides.first_step: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. The trophy pops when the mission ends.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable. Heist prep and the heist itself are both part of the same mission chain.

guides.first_step: Complete the story mission Child's Play. The trophy pops when the mission ends.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story mission trophy.

guides.first_step: Complete the story mission Headliners. The trophy pops when the mission ends.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story mission trophy.

guides.first_step: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The trophy pops when the mission ends.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story mission trophy. Do not confuse it with the airport trophy (Catch Me If You Can), which is a separate, missable stunt at the same airport.

guides.first_step: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The trophy pops when the mission ends.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story mission trophy.

guides.first_step: Reach 100% completion. That means the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles, the activities and the counted grinds — everything the in-game completion stat tracks.
guides.watch_out: This is the long grind and the last gold before the platinum. When it stalls, check the completion stat category by category instead of guessing: the short category is the one to chase.

guides.first_step: Pull off stunts — jumps, near-misses, airtime and the like — until the PSN count reaches 250. Any stunt counts; spread them across your normal driving and the total climbs on its own.
guides.watch_out: A pure count, not a single hard trick. Check the PSN progress target to see how far along you are, and do not chase one perfect stunt when 250 ordinary ones will do.

guides.first_step: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 types in total — races, fishing, arcade, shooting range, drone races, meditation, hunting, bowling and the rest of the activity list — so sample one of each.
guides.watch_out: Trying is enough: you do not have to win or master any of them. Tick each type off as you sample it so none is left untried.

guides.first_step: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the range's challenge list one weapon or drill at a time and repeat any challenge until it clears gold.
guides.watch_out: 42 golds is the whole set — a silver on even one challenge blocks the trophy. Learn each challenge's gold threshold, then repeat it until you beat it.

guides.first_step: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 locations, so win one race at each of them.
guides.watch_out: A win at 13 of 14 locations is not enough. Keep a checklist of the locations and revisit the ones you have not won yet.

guides.first_step: Win 20 different races. Each distinct race you win adds one, so work through the race list instead of replaying the same race.
guides.watch_out: Replays of a race you already won do not add to the count. New races only.

guides.first_step: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take the fishing challenge against Cal and out-fish him.
guides.watch_out: It is a head-to-head challenge, not free fishing: you have to beat Cal specifically, so treat it as a contest and not a relaxing cast.

guides.first_step: Complete an arcade game — play one through to its end. Any arcade game counts.
guides.watch_out: Starting one is not enough; it has to be completed. Pick the shortest game you are comfortable with.

guides.first_step: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's mission strand to its last mission and finish it.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable as long as you follow Andy's strand through. The official description names only the final mission.

guides.first_step: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's mission strand to its last mission and finish it.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story strand trophy.

guides.first_step: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's mission strand to its last mission and finish it.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story strand trophy.

guides.first_step: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Take stranger missions whenever they appear on the map and see each strand through to its end.
guides.watch_out: It is 8 full strands, not 8 single missions. A strand only counts when its last mission is done, so finish what you start.

guides.first_step: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's mission strand to its last mission and finish it.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story strand trophy.

guides.first_step: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's mission strand to its last mission and finish it.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story strand trophy.

guides.first_step: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 spots; visit each one and meditate there.
guides.watch_out: One missed spot blocks the trophy. The official description gives the count (18) but no map, so tick each spot off as you visit it.

guides.first_step: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting task and bring down the unique animal it names.
guides.watch_out: It has to be the unique animal for Bret, not any animal. The official description does not name the species or the spot, so follow Bret's task itself.

guides.first_step: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find cards across Leonida and finish three full sets.
guides.watch_out: A set only counts when it is complete. Keep your sets organised — a single missing card in each of three sets is worth nothing.

guides.first_step: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. Find the WAiNK spots as you travel and use the interaction at each one until the count reaches 100.
guides.watch_out: A spot only counts once, so 100 distinct locations are needed. The official description gives the count but no map — mark each spot you use.

guides.first_step: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; work through them across activities and missions until 50 are done.
guides.watch_out: Any 50 challenges count, so take the easy ones first. Check the challenge list to see which are already done.

guides.first_step: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose it and escape the heat together. Stay close to your partner through the chase until the wanted level clears.
guides.watch_out: MISSABLE: it needs your partner present and a 4-star chase you survive together. Do it while partner missions are still available — later in the story your partner may not be around to do it with.

guides.first_step: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level at any point. Chain the three robberies in one run, keeping the heat the whole way.
guides.watch_out: MISSABLE: it needs your partner and three shops in a row with the wanted level held, not lost. Plan the route first — a lost wanted level or a missing partner ends the attempt.

guides.first_step: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive, ride or spot new vehicles across Leonida until the count reaches 100 — variety is what counts.
guides.watch_out: Duplicates do not add to the count. Try a new vehicle every time you see one you have not driven yet.

guides.first_step: In a single use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Trigger Combat Focus in a fight with at least five enemies close together and drop all five before it ends.
guides.watch_out: All five must fall inside one Combat Focus use. Pick a busy fight, not a quiet one, and save the attempt for when the enemies are grouped.

guides.first_step: At VCIA airport, make an unscheduled departure — leave by air without a scheduled flight. Get a plane off the ground at the airport and away.
guides.watch_out: MISSABLE: the official description describes a single departure at the airport, not a repeatable activity. Try it early, while you can still reach the airport freely — treat it as a one-shot stunt.

guides.first_step: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. The official description is deliberately vague ('Kinda hot in these Rhinos'), so take on a Rhino in open combat and survive it.
guides.watch_out: The description pins down no exact method, so the honest guide is: find a Rhino, fight it, and stay alive. Do not trust a walkthrough that claims a precise script the description never gives.

guides.first_step: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the entry, stay out of sight, and get out with the loot before anyone raises the alarm.
guides.watch_out: Detection fails the attempt, not the trophy — you can retry. Go quiet and slow rather than fast and loud.

guides.first_step: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape from each one. Work through five vault robberies, getting clear after every one.
guides.watch_out: Each vault needs the escape as well as the robbery. A vault cracked but not escaped does not count.

guides.first_step: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit the truck, take the money, and get away clean.
guides.watch_out: The escape is part of the trophy. Lose the heat after the robbery or the attempt does not count.

guides.first_step: Explore all of Leonida. There are 52 areas to visit; cover the whole map until every area has been discovered.
guides.watch_out: One unvisited area blocks the trophy. The official description gives the count (52) but no map — sweep methodically, region by region.

guides.first_step: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs, so hit one operation for each of them.
guides.watch_out: One operation per gang — nine in total. Hitting the same gang twice does not add to the count.

guides.first_step: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find the cocktail spot with the view, and have the drink.
guides.watch_out: It is the cocktail with the view that counts, not just any drink. The official description names Ocean Beach and the view, and no other place.

guides.first_step: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle straight through the showroom and out the other side.
guides.watch_out: The showroom exit has to be smashed through, not walked out of. Pick a fast, heavy vehicle for the run.

guides.first_step: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — bowl a full game there.
guides.watch_out: The alley matters: it has to be the Kolt & Associates' alley the description names. Bowling anywhere else does not count.

guides.first_step: Build a partnership with mass appeal. The official description is a riddle, not instructions — play through the partnership content and its public moments and the trophy will come with it.
guides.watch_out: The description pins down no single action, so no honest guide can name one. Follow the partnership strand and check the trophy after each of its big moments.

guides.first_step: Make choices — for better or worse — until the PSN count reaches 500. Choices across the game add up, so keep choosing whenever the game offers one.
guides.watch_out: MISSABLE: the count is 500 choices, and choices are made as the story and side content offer them. Do not rush past choice moments without choosing — a skipped choice is a choice you never made.

guides.first_step: Succeed on a second try. Fail something, then go straight back and succeed at it the second time.
guides.watch_out: The trophy is about the retry, not the failure: you need a first failure followed by a success. A first-time success does not count.

guides.first_step: Witness something strange. Explore Leonida's odd corners — the strange events are out there waiting to be found.
guides.watch_out: The description is deliberately cryptic and names no place. Explore, keep your eyes open, and do not trust a guide that claims a precise spot the description never gives.

guides.first_step: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. Drive past someone on foot and knock them down with a melee attack from the vehicle.
guides.watch_out: It has to be a melee drive-by — from the vehicle, with a melee weapon, while moving. A drive-by shooting or a crash does not count.

guides.first_step: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Run marked bills through your laundering contacts until $250,000 is clean.
guides.watch_out: Only laundered marked bills count toward the $250,000. Keep the money moving through contacts instead of spending the bills raw.

guides.first_step: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy gear, clothes, food and anything else across the shops of Leonida until the total passes $100,000.
guides.watch_out: Spending counts across all shops, so there is no need to blow it in one place. Big purchases — vehicles and property — are the fastest way up.

guides.first_step: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garages; buy every one of them.
guides.watch_out: All 8 are required. Keep the money for them — spending it elsewhere first only delays the trophy.

guides.first_step: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Take ten different vehicles and register each one in the app.
guides.watch_out: Ten distinct registrations are needed. A vehicle already registered does not count twice.

note: Guide entries written fresh for this entry, in the author's own words. Every entry is grounded in the trophy's official PlayStation description (names, descriptions, grades and counts as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles). Where the official description does not pin down a place or a step, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

roadmap.blurb: Finish every chapter and every named story mission. These trophies cannot be missed: they pop when the mission or chapter ends, so just keep playing.
roadmap.title: Play the story through

roadmap.blurb: Four trophies depend on a partner being with you, a one-off departure, or choices you make along the way. Do these while the window is open; the rest of the game can wait.
roadmap.title: Mind the missable windows

roadmap.blurb: Work through the activities one at a time — stunts, ranges, races, fishing, arcade, meditation, hunting and the rest. Counts are tracked by PSN, so chip away at them between missions.
roadmap.title: Activities, races and skills

roadmap.blurb: Sweep the map for cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles and all 52 areas, rob the vaults and gang operations, and move the money: launder $250,000, spend $100,000, buy the garages and register the cars.
roadmap.title: Collectibles, the map and money

roadmap.blurb: Push completion to 100% — the last gold — and the platinum pops with it. Check the in-game completion stat and mop up whichever category is still short.
roadmap.title: Platinum cleanup
